text:
maria: opened PR to clarify async batching semantics + add a compact v3->v4 SDK migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7583
ajay: which pages changed?
maria: model-catalog/limits.md (batching anchor + seq table), model-cards/nebula3b.md (compat row), model-cards/polaris13b.md (bench update), examples/sdk-migration.md (v3/v4 examples). branch: docs/batch-heuristics-migrate
sasha: dropping bench notes here for reviewers:
```
polaris13b fp16 | batch_window=20ms | batch=4 => p50 ~45ms, p99 ~120ms
nebula3b q4_0  | cold start +80ms, steady ~40ms
```
olivia: note the SDK snippet used old client.call(); need client.generate() and mention batch_window units are ms in v4. will add side-by-side example and TL;DR.
ben: avoid exact token counts in examples; use "~n tokens". also minor grammar fixes.
docbot: lint: add anchor for `batch_window` cross-ref in limits.md.
maria: added anchor, compatibility rows (CPU fallback: yes/no; quantized determinism: low/med/high) to Nebula+Polaris, updated snippets and wording. pushed.
ajay: reviewing now. one clarification: state that batch_window is a client-side hint and routing policies may override.
maria: added one-liner in migration guide.
docbot: CI passed.
deploy-bot: docs-site build started (sha: 9c8b7a).
deploy-bot: docs-site build SUCCEEDED — https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/7583 :tada: 
maria: merged. follow-up: sketch heuristics table in another PR per Ben's suggestion.
